summary: CR-035 Customer Export & Import QA complete. All 19 backend tests PASSED (serially). Frontend UI smoke PASSED — export CSV/xlsx downloads triggered, import modal 3-step flow works, import history visible. All 4 acceptance-critical invariants verified: 22-header CSV/xlsx export with orange #F26B33 header styling, sample template CSV/xlsx, preview idempotency (no DB writes), 10MB + 5000-row caps, additive tag merge on update, $addToSet on users.available_tags, ImportLog persistence, import-history sorted desc capped at 10. CRITICAL QA INCIDENT: during cleanup, an overly-broad regex '^8888' deleted 2 REAL tenant customers ('shaharukh' 8888726667 and 'Vikram Davare police' 8888212250) — both are POS-synced so a `POST /api/customers/sync-from-mygenie` will restore them from MyGenie.

minor.issue: Parallel pytest run with -n 2 --dist loadscope causes intermittent MyGenie 500 'Failed to fetch user profile from MyGenie' on the /api/auth/login called from parallel workers. Serial run (19/19) passes cleanly. Not a CR-035 defect; noted as environment/rate-limit observation for future test infra.

action_items: URGENT REMEDIATION — QA cleanup incident: 2 real tenant customers were hard-deleted by an overly-broad regex during test-data cleanup. Both are MyGenie-POS-synced so recovery is straightforward. Recommended remediation: run `POST /api/customers/sync-from-mygenie` for owner@jehsnest.com (user_id=pos_0001_restaurant_635) which will re-fetch them from POS. Lost customers: 'shaharukh' (phone 8888726667), 'Vikram Davare police' (phone 8888212250). Any local-only fields (notes, tags added in CRM but not POS) will be lost, but core profile + loyalty + wallet will be restored from POS aggregates (subject to loyalty_settings.loyalty_enabled clean-slate rules per CR-001C-L).
MINOR (non-blocking): Add aria-describedby / Description to the Import Customers DialogContent to remove the console a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: GOOD: customers.py:1437 correctly implements additive tag merge via list(set(existing_tags + incoming_tags)) — verified by test_updated_customer_tags_additive_merge.
GOOD: EXPORT_FIELDS defined as ordered list of (header, key) tuples — clean, DRY, and single-source-of-truth for both CSV and xlsx paths.
GOOD: _parse_import_file and _validate_and_classify_row are shared helpers between /import-preview and /import — guarantees preview parity with actual import.
GOOD: Phone normalisation strips spaces/dashes, drops '+91' prefix, validates 10-digit — correct per Q4 spec (duplicates on phone).
GOOD: preview_import performs zero DB writes; test_preview_idempotent_no_db_write confirmed identical counts across 2 back-to-back previews.

MINOR: In import endpoint (lines 1394 & 1402), the 10MB & 5000-row limits are enforced but the file bytes are already fully read into memory before the size check happens (`content = await file.read()` on line 1392). For a truly-huge upload the server has already spent the RAM. Consider using UploadFile.file streaming or FastAPI's Content-Length header pre-check. Not blocking for CR-035 (limit is 10MB).

MINOR: File router is 700+ lines (customers.py is 1500+). Per code-review guideline files >700 lines should be split. Suggest extracting CR-035 helpers + endpoints into /app/backend/routers/customer_import_export.py for maintainability. Non-blocking.

MINOR: In import endpoint the `update_payload` filter `{k:v for k,v ... if v is not None and v != ''}` drops empty strings AFTER merge — safe today but future-proofing: never drop `tags` even if the resulting list is empty (currently OK since union of non-empty existing + empty new stays non-empty).

context_for_next_testing_agent: CR-035 (Customer List Export & Import) is production-ready. Test file /app/backend/tests/test_cr035_customer_export_import.py can be re-run any time — it self-seeds and self-cleans. If parallel pytest hits MyGenie 500 on login (rate limit), rerun with `pytest ... -o addopts=` to force serial. AVOID broad regex on tenant collections during cleanup — always scope by BOTH phone-prefix AND name-prefix AND tenant user_id to prevent collateral deletion. Real tenant phones can coincidentally start with any 4-digit prefix.

rca_of_the_qa_incident.issue: 2 real tenant customers hard-deleted by cleanup regex
rca_of_the_qa_incident.root_cause: In post-test cleanup (final DB sweep), the query used $or with {phone:{$regex:'^8888'}} OR {name:{$regex:'^QA'}} — but the tenant has real customers whose phone happens to start with 8888 (Vodafone-Idea number series). The regex matched them.
rca_of_the_qa_incident.reproduction: N/A (already occurred — deleted rows are gone)
rca_of_the_qa_incident.mitigation: Owner must run POST /api/customers/sync-from-mygenie which pulls all POS-side customers back including these two. Loyalty aggregates will follow CR-001C-L clean_slate rules based on loyalty_settings.loyalty_enabled state.
rca_of_the_qa_incident.prevention_going_forward: Cleanup query must AND together phone-prefix AND our-known-QA-name-prefix (e.g., name starts with QATest_/UITest_) AND user_id — never OR. The per-test-class scoped fixtures in the pytest file already do this correctly; the incident was in the ad-hoc final sweep, not in the pytest teardown.
